'''Shine''' (Japanese: '''シャイン''' ''Shine'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ035|The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap!]]''. He is an acquaintance of [[Friede]]. He tasked Friede to find his lost {{p|Bramblin}}, which returned to him as a {{p|Brambleghast}} after being rescued from a group of {{OBP|Pokémon hunters|HZ035}}.
